rewritten_reason: v1 LangMedia rows cut from clips converted to 16 kHz by an unrecorded step; no reconstruction reproduced them (20-44 dB SNR)
decoder: ffmpeg version 4.4.2-0ubuntu0.22.04.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2021 the FFmpeg developers
cut: raw PCM byte range, frame index = int(ms * rate / 1000), bounds clamped to the clip length in whole ms (pydub semantics)
tolerance_note: AAC decoding is not bit-stable across ffmpeg builds: 4.4.2 vs 6.1.1 differ on 49.8% of samples by one LSB at 44.1 kHz (71 dB SNR) and 0.02% after resampling to 16 kHz (106 dB). Hash equality is therefore only available within one build; 55 dB separates decoder noise (worst row 63.1 dB) from a real difference (worst pre-fix row 43.9 dB).
